resume_text: no formal cs background. was a logistics coordinator. got annoyed at a manual rota process so i built a thing to fix it. it schedules 200+ shift workers, has a fallback when the model is unsure (kicks to a human), been running 14 months at my old depot, they still use it. also made a little library for the rota constraints that two other depots picked up. not great at slide decks. happy to show the code and walk through why i made each call.
